description: This file defines the AttendanceConfiguration class in the OrangeHRM attendance module, encapsulating attendance-related permissions such as user ability to change current time, modify attendance, and supervisor modifications. It includes getter and setter methods for these boolean properties.

classes.name: AttendanceConfiguration
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for setting and retrieving user permissions related to attendance modifications in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Returns whether the user can change the current time.

methods.name: setCanUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Sets whether the user can change the current time.

methods.name: canUserModifyAttendance
methods.description: Returns whether the user can modify attendance.

methods.name: setCanUserModifyAttendance
methods.description: Sets whether the user can modify attendance.

methods.name: canSupervisorModifyAttendance
methods.description: Returns whether a supervisor can modify attendance.

methods.name: setCanSupervisorModifyAttendance
methods.description: Sets whether a supervisor can modify attendance.
